4) The problem was exacerbated because Dogecoin used the Scrypt hashing algorithm, the same as LTC. Scrypt ASICs started emerging around this time, and the risk of 51% attack was real. Miners could launch double spend attacks without making their hardware useless.

Dogecoin inflation was super aggressive. The block rewards schedule was based off bitcoin's (with more units), but happened 20x faster. Dogecoin is permanently inflationary, but the drop off in block rewards was HUGE. https://t.co/E0HoKjNP0D
